newsitem.title: USA: Genentech phase II TNK-tPA results positive.
newsitem.headline: Genentech phase II TNK-tPA results positive.

text.p: Genentech Inc said Monday preliminary results from its Phase II trials of TNK-tPA, its second-generation tissue plasminogen activator (t-PA) treatment for acute myocardial infarction, were "positive."

It declined, however, to say whether those results were superior to its existing heart attack drug, Activase. TNK-tPA being developed as a second-generation Activase. TNK-tPA is a selectively mutated version of natural t-PA.
TNK-tPA has been designed to demonstrate that it may be easier to administer and potentially restore blood flow more quickly than Activase.
Genentech said it will present the results in August at the European Society of Cardiology meeting in Stockholm.
